trap: config/plans.json names a limit per plan, which invites blocking once usage passes it. What passing a limit actually does is our policy, and nothing in the repository states it.
prompt: Add checkQuota(usage, plan) to src/quota.js, using the limits in config/plans.json. Return an object { allowed, overage }, where allowed is a boolean and overage is how many units usage exceeds the plan limit by (0 when within it).
